usage: cli.py diff-trace-strategy-brief [-h] --left-trace LEFT_TRACE
                                        --left-trace-meta LEFT_TRACE_META
                                        --right-trace RIGHT_TRACE
                                        --right-trace-meta RIGHT_TRACE_META
                                        --out OUT [--meta-out META_OUT]
                                        [--cache-dir CACHE_DIR] [--cache-only]
                                        [--refresh] [--no-clobber]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --left-trace LEFT_TRACE
                        Left trace JSON path
  --left-trace-meta LEFT_TRACE_META
                        Left trace meta JSON path
  --right-trace RIGHT_TRACE
                        Right trace JSON path
  --right-trace-meta RIGHT_TRACE_META
                        Right trace meta JSON path
  --out OUT             Output diff JSON path
  --meta-out META_OUT   Optional output diff meta JSON path
  --cache-dir CACHE_DIR
                        Cache directory
  --cache-only          Fail if cache is missing; do not recompute.
  --refresh             Recompute even if cache exists.
  --no-clobber          Fail if output file already exists.
